run_bm_blending: run the bm_blending benchmark for sigmoid alpha, softmax, and splatter blending on CUDA
test_bm_sigmoid_alpha_blending: test the bm_sigmoid_alpha_blending benchmark across multiple image sizes and faces per pixel
test_bm_softmax_blending: test the bm_softmax_blending benchmark using the pytorch backend only
test_bm_splatter_blending: test the bm_splatter_blending benchmark with limited faces per pixel values
review_bm_blending: review the bm_blending function to understand benchmark test case generation and execution
